title: Convenient Semi-Friend
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Suuna, a lonely, anxious high-school girl, moves into a school dorm hoping to make friends and finds her roommate Ruka, who has a reputation among peers, being physically intimate with another girl. Suuna proposes they become 'semi-friends with benefits', a 4-koma comedy about two girls negotiating closeness (Yen Press blurb; Anime UK News).
life_message: Real friendship and closeness are worth the awkward effort, even when they begin from a misunderstanding.

content.note: High-school girls in a 'friends with benefits' arrangement; semi-clothed touching and suggestive poses, no sex in volume 1; Yen rates it M (Anime UK News; MU Mature, Promiscuous Female Lead).
Suuna's loneliness and anxiety drive the story (review; MU Insecurity).
Casual physical intimacy between minors presented as comedy; reviewer notes an unbalanced dynamic.
